title: Monitoring stack
description: Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana and the exporters running on mon01.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (prometheus_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Prometheus", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (alertmanager_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Alertmanager", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (grafana_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Grafana", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (blackbox_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "blackbox_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (snmp_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "snmp_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (node_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "node_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (frr_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "frr_exporter", "", "")

panels.title: TSDB size
panels.description: Blocks + WAL + head chunks. Retention is capped by time and size in monitoring-config.

panels.title: mon01 disk free
panels.description: Free space on the backend VM's root filesystem, where the Prometheus data lives.

panels.title: Notifications dropped / errors
panels.description: Alerts Prometheus failed to deliver to Alertmanager in the selected range.

panels.title: Targets by job
panels.description: Scrape targets per job. Down targets are mostly hosts that don't run an exporter yet.

panels.title: Rule group evaluation
panels.description: A group whose duration nears its interval misses evaluations.

panels.title: Scrape interval (p99)
panels.description: Actual time between scrapes; should track the configured interval.

panels.title: Notifications by integration
panels.description: Everything routes to the null receiver for now, so this stays at 0.

panels.title: Grafana
panels.description: Both Grafanas share one Postgres database, so these are the same on each.

panels.title: Datasource requests
panels.description: Queries Grafana sends to its datasources (only while someone views a dashboard).

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Connections to the shared Postgres on mon01.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second (1 = one core).
